name: Caused Someone's Death
desc: There was an accident, or it was called one. They never corrected the record.

name: Lied About Their Profession
desc: The diploma, the license, the war record — one of them is invented.

name: Was Escaping Prosecution
desc: Somewhere behind them a courtroom is waiting with their name on the docket.

name: Recognizes Another Passenger
desc: One face in the party is familiar — from a night they have tried to forget.

name: Has Been on the Train Before
desc: The corridors are familiar. The smell is familiar. That should not be possible.

name: Died Before the Game Began
desc: They remember cold water, or the hospital ceiling, or the rope. Then the train.

name: Was Involved in Creating the Train
desc: In another life they signed drawings, or contracts, or consecrations, for something like this.

name: Carries a Forbidden Object
desc: Sewn into a coat lining is a thing that should have been destroyed.

name: Has Memories That Belong to Another
desc: Some of what they remember happened to someone else in the party.

name: Was Sent to Kill Someone in the Party
desc: They took the money. They boarded. They have not yet decided.

name: Is Already Partly Corrupted
desc: The train marked them long before this journey began. It is patient.
